goals.rationale: The person opens the kettle, fills it with tap water, and places it on its base to boil.

goals.description: Prepare the saucepan with boiling salted water
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a saucepan, places it on the cooker, pours boiling water from the kettle into it, and adds salt.
The person turns on the scales, places the pasta on them to measure the correct amount, and then sets it aside.

goals.description: Add pasta to the boiling water and cover the pan
goals.rationale: The person opens the pasta packet, pours it into the boiling water, shakes the pan to prevent sticking, and covers it with a lid.
